oliver_fiddler.text: Pull up a bench. Tuesday is the slow session, when every tune is played at the speed of a Sunday walk.
Oliver Plunkett Street is named for Saint Oliver Plunkett, an archbishop made a saint in 1975. He was the first Irish saint in over 700 years.
In Cork you will hear 'boy' for everyone and 'like' at the end of everything, like. It is a very efficient accent.
